# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), the rules for every AI coding agent in this
repository, and [AGENTS-ONBOARDING.md](../AGENTS-ONBOARDING.md) for the
layout, conventions and how to run the tests. Key rules: pnpm only (never
npm/npx), AGPLv3 headers on every new .js/.mjs/.css file, never edit
`api/vendor/**` or `public/js/vendor/**`, D1 migrations are CREATE-only, and
every read must respect the visibility law (hidden, banned, blocked).
